subject: NovusCorp Exec Workshop — escort plan & hybrid bridge
messages:
From: Bethany Cole <bethany@novuscorp.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Adam Li <adam.li@novuscorp.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: NovusCorp exec workshop — arrival windows and on-site needs

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for agreeing to run the exec workshop in Seattle 8/16-8/17. We wanted to lock down a couple of operational things so we can circulate final invites:

- VIP arrival windows: a handful of execs will arrive on the evening of 8/15 (between 6–9pm) and several on the morning of 8/16 (6–9am).
- On-site escort/security: we need a plan for a named Redwood escort for each arrival window and an expedited badge process.
- Hybrid setup: three rooms need a video bridge (main room + two breakout rooms) with failover between Zoom and Teams.
- Parking & access: would appreciate pre-printed parking passes and visitor badges.
- Dietary restrictions: at least 3 vegetarian, 1 gluten-free, 1 kosher.

Can you confirm who from Redwood will handle the escort, AV contact, and how parking/pass handoff works? Also please send the finalized run-of-show we can add to calendar invites.

Appreciate it — Bethany
Bethany Cole
Director, Executive Programs | NovusCorp

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Bethany Cole <bethany@novuscorp.com>
Cc: Adam Li <adam.li@novuscorp.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-02T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NovusCorp exec workshop — arrival windows and on-site needs

Bethany — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below: 

- Redwood escort: I'll be the primary escort for the 8/16 morning arrivals; Laura will cover the 8/15 evening arrivals and the late departures on 8/17. Monica will manage badges and on-site welcome table.
- AV ownership: Aditya will be our AV lead and will validate the video bridge, the back-up route, and bring a spare HDMI/USB-C kit.
- Parking/passes: Monica will generate pre-printed visitor badges and two 24-hour parking passes per corporate car. We'll drop these at concierge by 2pm on 8/15.
- Dietary: noted — please share attendee names for the diet constraints; we'll push to caterer and mark badges.
- Run-of-show: attaching a draft (venue_agenda_v3.pdf) — highlights: 8/16 main workshop 9am–4:30pm, exec prep room 8–9am, evening reception 6–8pm.

Action items for NovusCorp (can you confirm back):
1) Final attendee list and arrival times (by 8/6).
2) Parking blacklist/plate exceptions if any (by 8/10).

I copied Laura/Monica/Aditya to coordinate logistics and confirm breaks/AV test windows on 8/15 afternoon. If you prefer a quick ops call this week I can schedule 30 mins.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
mobile: +1 (415) 555-0183

Team — internal checklist and owners (I'll drop these into the shared folder after):

- Pre-printed badges & badge list (owner: Monica) — Monica to confirm the CSV by 8/7.
- Parking passes (owner: Monica) — order two reserved passes for execs arriving 8/15 evening and two for 8/16 morning. Confirm license plates by 8/10.
- Escort schedule (owner: Sean/Laura) — Laura to confirm evening escorts; Sean leads morning. Please create a shared signal channel for live check-ins.
- AV run-of-show + bridge failover test (owner: Aditya) — test Zoom->Teams failover on 8/15 at 3pm local. Bring spare Teams room key.
- Security visit & emergency contact (owner: Laura) — call facility security on 8/12 to confirm after-hours access and emergency egress plan.
- VIP gifts & dietary labels (owner: Sean) — label badges in the welcome envelope with dietary icons.

On the topic of the bridge, recommendation: primary Zoom meeting with a Teams dial-in fallback. Aditya — can you provision an alternate static SIP address for the main room so Novus onsite can patch if the primary cloud bridge has an issue?

Laura
Head of Customer Events | Redwood Inference

Bethany / team — quick AV confirmation after the walk-through this morning at the venue: 

- Main room: Crestron controlled with dual redundancy. We'll run the Zoom host from Redwood laptop A and have a secondary Teams host on laptop B.
- Breakouts: two AV carts with dedicated USB cameras and mics; each breakout will have a local moderator from Novus (please confirm names).
- Failover: scheduled test on 8/15 at 15:00 PT; if primary fails we'll flip to Teams and dial SIP; we will keep a wired fallback to the venue's codec.
- Remote recording: getting permission from Novus to record the main session — Bethany, confirm if recordings are OK for internal sharing.
- Onsite contact: Viktor (venue AV) — +1 206-555-0149, will be onsite 8/15–8/17.

I'll attach the AV checklist and list of cabling spares to the shared booking (link below). Monica — can you confirm that the printed parking passes will go to venue concierge no later than 2pm 8/15?

Thanks,
